highlights.excerpt: One of the funny reasons for the difference in vibes between the influencers and the crowd today on 6.2 Sol/Astra is that we gave a few folks access a while ago and then made a lot of changes in the last 3-4 days and I'm pretty sure no re-testing was done within those days and the videos were produced last week.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 今天网红和大众对 6.2 Sol/Astra 观感反差的一个有趣原因是：我们早些时候给了少数人试用资格，随后又在最近 3–4 天做了大量改动；我基本确定那些天里没有重新测试，视频也是上周拍的。
highlights.name: Tibo
highlights.text_zh: 称 GPT-6.2 评测视频多在改模型前拍的，没赶上近 3–4 天的更新。

highlights.excerpt: A huge percentage of my life is spent avoiding crowds. Avoiding fashionable ideas, investing in underpriced assets, finding cool places that aren't deluged with tourists — they're all variants of the same thing. Whenever I find myself in a crowd, I feel something is wrong.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我人生很大一部分时间都花在避开人群上。避开时髦想法、投资被低估的资产、寻找还没被游客淹没的好地方——这些其实都是同一件事的变体。每当我发现自己身处人群之中，就会觉得有什么不对。
highlights.name: Paul Graham
highlights.text_zh: 人生很大一部分是在避开人群：时髦想法、被高估的资产和过热景点。

highlights.excerpt: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon! Pushing the frontier across domains and punching above its model class in a meaningful way. To me, Neon feels like the right balance of intelligence, speed, and usability. Available now across @GoogleAIStudio, the API, and more! https://t.co/ANqCSTEWcS
highlights.excerpt_zh: 介绍 Gemini 4 Neon！它在多个领域推进前沿，并且切实超越了同级别模型。对我来说，Neon 在智力、速度和易用性之间取得了恰到好处的平衡。现已在 @GoogleAIStudio、API 等渠道开放！ https://t.co/ANqCSTEWcS
highlights.name: Logan Kilpatrick
highlights.text_zh: 推出 Gemini 4 Neon，认为它在智力、速度和易用性之间取得平衡。

highlights.excerpt:
Gemini 4 Neon is rolling out now.

Sitting between Carbon and Hydrogen, it brings frontier intelligence and fast task completion for complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
Gemini 4 Neon 现已开始推送。

它介于 Carbon 与 Hydrogen 之间，为复杂软件工程、知识工作和科学带来前沿智力与快速任务完成。
highlights.name: Google DeepMind
highlights.text_zh: Gemini 4 Neon 开始推送，定位介于 Carbon 与 Hydrogen，面向复杂工程与科学。

highlights.excerpt: I’m convinced that one of the greatest gifts you can give your children is letting them see you enjoy your life. Laugh with your spouse. Get excited about a hobby. Go on adventures with friends. Do hard things you love. Pursue something meaningful. Children embody what they see.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我确信，你能给孩子的最珍贵礼物之一，就是让他们看见你享受自己的生活。和伴侣一起笑。为爱好感到兴奋。和朋友去冒险。去做你热爱的难事。追求有意义的事。孩子会把他们看见的活成自己。
highlights.name: Sahil Bloom
highlights.text_zh: 给孩子最好的礼物之一，是让他们看见你享受自己的生活。

highlights.excerpt:
Working with @AMD, our models identified up to 14% PPA improvement on flagship GPU IP in less than five months—building on designs AMD’s engineers had already spent years optimizing.

The same approach helped improve Jalapeño, our first custom inference chip, with gains verified on real silicon.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
与 @AMD 合作，我们的模型在不到五个月内，在 AMD 工程师已经打磨多年的旗舰 GPU IP 上又找出了最高 14% 的 PPA 提升。

同一方法也改进了我们首款自研推理芯片 Jalapeño，增益已在真实芯片上得到验证。
highlights.name: OpenAI
highlights.text_zh: 与 AMD 合作，不到五个月在已优化的旗舰 GPU 上再挖出最高 14% PPA。
